title: Contain the Rosette /export-cnc manufacturing emitter behind RMOS authority (Phase A)
intent: Resolve the shared manufacturing-output authority before any Rosette /export-cnc generation, persist the exact authorized G-code, and emit governed headers. Containment and authority convergence only — not Rosette qualification, new machining physics, or a route redesign.
behavior_change: POST /api/rmos/rosette/export-cnc now resolves compute_rosette_feasibility (via require_manufacturing_output_authority) before segmentation, slices, CNC export, G-code, or job-id creation. A blocking decision (RED/UNKNOWN/ERROR) returns HTTP 409 SAFETY_BLOCKED with no program and a single BLOCKED audit artifact; a permitted decision persists the exact returned G-code once and stamps X-Run-ID, X-ToolBox-Lane: governed, and X-GCode-SHA256. Impossible geometry is rejected before authority as a handled non-authority error. /rosette/design is unchanged in Phase A.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Added the pure helpers _rosette_ring_feasibility_summary (single-ring geometry derivation, raising ValueError for impossible geometry) and _set_governed_output_headers in a new module app/rmos/rosette_output_authority.py (a narrow extraction required by the 500-line file-size ratchet), and wired require_manufacturing_output_authority + persist_authorized_manufacturing_output into export_rosette_cnc before any generation. Added tests/rmos/test_cf2_rosette_output_containment.py (REX-01..14). Regenerated the manufacturing-output inventory JSON/MD so /api/rmos/rosette/export-cnc moves LIVE_UNGOVERNED -> FAIL_CLOSED. Updated the probe containment test's live-ungoverned count 15 -> 14.
diff_articulation.why: POST /api/rmos/rosette/export-cnc was a CONFIRMED_EMITTER / LIVE_UNGOVERNED / authority_layer=none route: it generated CNC G-code with no server-side authority. This converges it onto the existing RMOS manufacturing-output authority so blocking decisions cannot emit a program and permitted decisions are persisted under the exact decision that authorized them.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No authority previously gated this route; the route's internal export_bundle.safety_decision is an advisory field, not the RMOS manufacturing-output authority, and did not fail closed before generation. The shared authority service (require/persist) already exists but was not called by this route. This adds the missing pre-generation gate and the audit persistence, changing only this one emitter.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No machining physics, geometry algorithms, G-code generators, feasibility rules/thresholds/risk mappings, authentication, response JSON fields (beyond the intentional 409 refusal path and governed headers), persistence stores/schemas, or /rosette/design behavior. The shared classifier app/ci/manufacturing_output_classify.py was NOT modified.
diff_articulation.why_structural_extraction: The feasibility-summary and header helpers were extracted into app/rmos/rosette_output_authority.py because adding them inline pushed rosette_cam_router.py past the 500-line file-size ratchet; the order explicitly permits a narrow extraction in that case. The route still uses compute_rosette_feasibility only through the shared require_manufacturing_output_authority, not by calling the evaluator directly.

order_deviations.tool_id: The order's Decision #5.2 froze tool_id="rosette" (bare). Reproduced evidence: resolve_mode("rosette") -> "unknown" -> no engine -> UNKNOWN -> always 409, so the bare id can never reach compute_rosette_feasibility. Corrected to tool_id="rosette:export_cnc" (mode="rosette"), matching the profiling:gcode precedent, so the real evaluator is reached (natural YELLOW permit observed).
order_deviations.containment_disposition: The order's Decision #5.12 / §8 / REX-14 required containment=PERMITTED_BY_AUTHORITY and authority_key=rosette. Reproduced evidence: the static classifier _containment never emits PERMITTED_BY_AUTHORITY (it is a dead enum value; governed-before-generation-with-key classifies as FAIL_CLOSED), and --check forbids hand-editing generated row facts. Per owner true-A ruling, the row is FAIL_CLOSED with authority_key=rosette:export_cnc and the shared classifier is left unmodified. FAIL_CLOSED is the static containment label (authority runs before generation and blocks when unavailable/blocking); it does not mean every request is refused — the real evaluator still returns a non-blocking YELLOW. Decision #5.12 and the earlier exact-allowlist probe-assertion ruling are superseded by this classifier-contract evidence; the PERMITTED_BY_AUTHORITY set remains empty and the probe global no-permitted assertion is unchanged.

commands_run: cd services/api && python -m pytest tests/test_rosette_cnc_export_endpoint_smoke.py tests/test_rmos_rosette_cnc_smoke.py tests/test_rmos_endpoint_smoke.py tests/rmos/test_cf2_probe_output_containment.py tests/rmos/test_manufacturing_authority_stage2.py tests/rmos/test_rmos_feasibility_authority.py -q --no-cov
proofs: Authority precedes all generation and persistence (AST source-order test REX-05; a misordered fixture fails).
Blocked request returns 409 SAFETY_BLOCKED with no program, governed lane, X-Run-ID, no X-GCode-SHA256, and exactly one BLOCKED artifact with no gcode hash and no OK artifact (REX-06/07/08).

Permitted request (real YELLOW) returns the existing JSON contract, calls each of the four export-stage generators exactly once, and X-GCode-SHA256 == sha256(returned gcode) == persisted artifact hash, with run ids matching (REX-09/10).
Persisted OK artifact carries the authority context's risk (YELLOW, not a synthesized GREEN), tool_id rosette:export_cnc, mode rosette, event_type rosette_export_cnc_execution (REX-11).

Evaluator request contains exactly the derived facts (outer/inner diameter, ring_count=1, material_id, rpm) and no invented depth/tool-diameter/pattern (REX-04); impossible inner geometry never reaches authority (REX-03).
Inventory moves only /api/rmos/rosette/export-cnc to FAIL_CLOSED; /rosette/design stays LIVE_UNGOVERNED; live-ungoverned total is 14; PERMITTED_BY_AUTHORITY set is empty (REX-14).
Existing GRBL/FANUC/material/spindle/alignment/safety/runtime/default-payload smoke contract remains green (REX-13 and tests/test_rosette_cnc_export_endpoint_smoke.py).
verification.hardware: No physical-machine execution and no manufacturing output. G-code is generated in tests only and never sent to a controller.

findings: MEDIUM: this change adds a fail-closed authority gate to a live manufacturing-output emitter. Risk concentrates in summary truthfulness, authority-before-generation ordering, and hash identity, all covered by direct tests (REX-04/05/10/11). No _experimental/ files are touched.
